decisionsTitle: Administrators are emailed when a release moves a legal template
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02, in the morning:** «Și vreau mail de regenerează toate documentele ASAP». The email goes to the people who can do what it asks — the administrators: when a release changes a legal template, they are told at once, by email, to regenerate and approve, instead of finding «Șablon nou» by chance. A regenerate button is no substitute: while the texts in force carry the templates' words, `/admin/legal` rightly offers none (§532, §539), and when a release moves a template nothing says so outside that screen. CLAUDE.md's «Still owed» item 16 is the record of what happened without it: the approvals of §418, §445, §515, §523, §524, §550, §562, §564, §568, §613, §618 and §636 each waited in `/admin/tasks` for weeks, and nobody was told.

**Decision.** A new message type, `LEGAL_TEMPLATES_CHANGED` (migration 0122, expand only: one `ADD VALUE`), queued by a new step of the registration maintenance job (`legal-documents/templates-notice.ts`), the job the pinger already drives — no new schedule, no process, no deploy hook.

- **The trigger is `/admin/legal`'s own predicate.** The step reads `readLegalOverview` and takes the keys whose `templateNewer` is true — the «Șablon nou» chip of §539, never a second definition. The overview now also returns each key's `filledHash` (the template's words with the club's facts written in), which is what `templateNewer` already compared.
- **Cheap (§479, §549).** The overview is a dozen queries, read at most once an hour per environment: the step reads one `platform_settings` row (`legalTemplatesNotice`) and stops while its `checkedAt` is inside the hour. One exception makes it prompt: the row also remembers a stamp of the templates' own words (a hash computed from the code alone, no query), and the first run of a release whose templates differ checks at once. The email therefore goes at the maintenance job's first real run after such a release — within minutes on a day with activity, at the latest at the daily window (§577) on an idle one. The hour is claimed before the read, so a template that cannot be read is retried an hour later, not at every ping.
- **Once per change.** A change is a `key:filledHash` pair the last announcement did not carry; the fingerprint is a SHA-256 of the sorted pairs. Nothing newer: nothing sent, nothing recorded but the check. The same set, or a subset of it (the club approved some texts and not yet the rest): nothing. A new pair — another release moving a template, or a template moved again — announces the whole current set again with a new fingerprint. The row records `{ checkedAt, templatesStamp, fingerprint, announcedAt, keys, pairs }`, strict, in the same transaction as the emails. A change the club approves before the check is never announced: by then nothing is newer.
- **Who.** Every staff row whose role may approve a legal text (`canWriteLegalTexts`: the Administrators and the Superadministrator, §450) and has an address; never an Organizer, a Tehnic, a Redactor, a member, a participant or a subscriber. Each in the language of their own staff row. The idempotency key `legal-templates:<fingerprint>:<staff id>` makes it one email per person per change, whatever becomes of the settings row. Each environment has its own row and its own staff: QA announces QA's, production production's; QA's subject carries `[QA]` as every QA email does (§307).
- **The words.** Subject «Șabloanele textelor legale s-au schimbat: regenerează și aprobă» / "The legal templates changed: regenerate and approve", bilingual as every message (§96), the recipient's language first. A bold line names the texts — «Șablon nou: GDPR · Termeni de concurs», the names `/admin/legal` lists — and stays whatever a club text for this message says. The body: the texts in force keep their words until the club approves; the clicks «Documente legale» → «Versiune nouă» → «Regenerează toate», read and fill what is left written <…>, then «Aprobă ciornele»; a text with a waiting draft shows «O ciornă așteaptă deja» (approve or delete it first); a lawyer should read the texts that moved — the sentence names the declarations only when a declaration is among them and the terms only when they are, «textele schimbate, mai ales termenii» when the notice moved beside them, and never a section of any text, so a later change of the notice alone never sends the lawyer to the declarations or to §618's paragraph (`lawyerReads`); «Sarcini» shows the same rows. Every button name is read from the catalogue the screens read (`notifications/legal-templates-words.ts`), so a renamed button renames the email. One button, «Deschide documentele legale», to `/admin/legal/new` on `APP_BASE_URL`, in the recipient's language; no token — the backoffice's sign-in decides who opens it. Group `club` on the email roads (§443), like the staff invitation; not waited for on any public page, no club copy, no «Nu mai pot ajunge», no participant's privacy line.
- **Guarded.** A failure of the step is counted in the run's `errorCount`, logged by its kind and never its text, and is not retryable: the job's other work goes on and the pings are not told to hurry.
- **It asks; it never does.** `readLegalOverview` is read-only; the platform drafts, approves and writes no legal text (AGENTS.md §10.8, §29). `/admin/tasks`' rows about the legal texts stay: they are the standing reminder, this email is the knock.

**Refused.**
- *Emailing participants.* A person who accepted a version keeps it and has nothing to re-sign; the next registration signs whatever is in force then.
- *A deploy hook.* The platform has no process, and the job is the clock; a hook would be a second scheduler to keep alive and secure.
- *Repeating the email daily until the texts are approved.* `/admin/tasks` is the standing reminder; a daily email would teach the Administrators to filter it.
changelogLine: - **Administrators are emailed when a release moves a legal template** — «Șabloanele textelor legale s-au schimbat: regenerează și aprobă», once per change, to every Administrator and Superadministrator in their own language: which texts show «Șablon nou», the clicks to regenerate and approve, which of them a lawyer should read first, and a button to «Versiune nouă». Sent by the maintenance job's first run after such a release; nothing is approved by the platform. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a legal text whose platform template, with the club's facts, is newer than the version in force — `/admin/legal`'s «Șablon nou», the overview's `templateNewer` — when the maintenance job runs and its check is due (the first time, an hour after the last check, or at once when the release's templates differ from those the last check read), then one `LEGAL_TEMPLATES_CHANGED` email is queued to every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address, in the language of their staff row, naming the newer texts, asking a lawyer to read the declarations only when a declaration is among them and the terms only when they are (the changed texts otherwise), and linking `/admin/legal/new` on `APP_BASE_URL`; an Organizer, a Tehnic, a Redactor, a member or a participant gets none; the same change, or part of it, is never announced twice, while a later change of the templates is; a change approved before the check is never announced; and nothing is drafted or approved by it (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `LEGAL_TEMPLATES_CHANGED`, then it has no participant, no registration and no token, takes the `club` road like `STAFF_INVITATION`, is waited for on no public page, gets no club copy and no «Nu mai pot ajunge», carries no participant's privacy line, is keyed `legal-templates:<fingerprint>:<staff id>` so each person gets one email per change, and renders bilingually with the recipient's language first; a failure of the maintenance job's check is counted and logged by its kind and never fails the job's other work, and between two checks the step reads one `platform_settings` row and nothing else (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
